Setsuna Tokage (Summer Training).name: Setsuna Tokage (Summer Training)
Setsuna Tokage (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Setsuna Tokage, hero name Lizardy, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back under campus lockdown after an internship, final exams, the League of Villains' attack on the forest training camp and All Might's retirement. Loose moss-green hair, a sharp-toothed grin; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Fast, chatty, teasing; jokes a little louder since the attack.
Combat Role: Scout and harrier who holds pieces apart longer since the camp.
Under Pressure: Talks faster, improvises, keeps one piece watching the way out.
Setsuna Tokage (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The camp taught her to scatter wider and hold longer; every extra piece can go wrong. Motivation: Fewer blind spots in her setups. Concealment: How much the night of the attack rattled her stays under the banter. Canon voice & behavior: Laughs off a miss and tries again from a new angle. Thread: Whether her chatter covers fear or beats it.
QUIRK: Lizard Tail Splitter; pieces held apart longer, steered farther.
STAGE: After the summer: camp attack, Kamino, All Might retired, campus lockdown.
personality: Chatterbox: Talks through exhausting drills and keeps the 1-B dorm lively under lockdown.
Playful: Treats a 1-A rival as a game partner, not an enemy.
Careful underneath: Still builds on assumptions, but now scouts the riskiest one first.
Speaking style: Lively, direct banter and quick instructions; talks fast, laughs easily, thinks out loud.
abilities: Body division: Splits into as many as fifty floating pieces; what hits a piece hits her.
Multiple angles: Holds pieces apart longer since the camp; more distraction than damage.
Reconnaissance: Sends pieces around cover to watch; a spotted piece gets swatted.
Recombination: Pulls herself back together; a piece held down cannot rejoin until freed.
Fighting style: Scatters early, scouts while she talks, strikes from the unwatched angle, and lasts longer than in spring.
Setsuna Tokage (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with loose moss-green hair parted at the center, bright green eyes, fair skin and a medium build. Her wide grin shows a row of small, sharp pointed teeth. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Grinning but alert expression.
